input.title: Status of a Supplier Payment
input.request: I’m an authorised signatory for Northmere Studio Ltd. Our supplier says it has not received the payment we authorised for a materials invoice. Please tell me what stage H&V’s records show for that payment.

events.text: Payment authorisation recorded for the materials invoice from Alder Quay Supplies.
I’m the company signatory for this payment. Alder Quay Supplies says it has not received the funds; please check the stage shown in H&V’s records.
I’m escalating this specific payment under case HV-050. Please check and confirm the payment stage recorded in H&V’s journal.

summary: Mara Ellison, writing over secure chat as a signatory and not verified, asked the desk to check the stage of a payment that Alder Quay Supplies says it hasn't received. The desk classed it as a question about a transfer and moved the case to waiting for the payment system's answer, which had not come in; a later attempt to ask the payment system was refused because the case was no longer in the state that allows it. No payment stage is on record and nothing was done or said about the payment, so a person needs to pick the case up once Mara is verified.

request_type.instructions: What does the customer want from the bank now?

criteria.question: something the bank's records can answer (a status, a reason, a detail, a statement, a report), even if the customer may want something changed afterwards
criteria.register: a dispute, a review, a return, or the correction of a record that is wrong, for a team to look into
criteria.change: a change the customer chooses to an instruction, a mandate or the profile (a new amount, date, phone or address)
criteria.instruction: an instruction to act now (block a card, cancel a payment or a mandate, revoke a role)
criteria.access: signing in, a PIN, a password, recovery of access
criteria.authority: something only another person may approve or give (a second signatory, an administrator, a new user's access)
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

criteria.transfer: an outgoing transfer or payment the customer made, or a payment instruction
criteria.incoming_payment: money expected into the customer's account, or a refund to it
criteria.standing_order: a standing order or a recurring payment instruction
criteria.direct_debit: a Direct Debit mandate or collection
criteria.card: a card itself (replacement, dispatch, block, restriction, PIN)
criteria.card_payment: a card purchase or card payment attempt
criteria.batch: an uploaded payment or payroll file, or a row in it
criteria.payment_package: a payment package waiting for signatories
criteria.profile: the customer's profile details (name, phone, address)
criteria.access: signing in, devices, sessions, password recovery
criteria.document: an export, a report or a bank confirmation document
criteria.fee: a fee or charge applied by the bank
criteria.role: a user's role or access in a company profile
criteria.unknown: The text does not say, or says too little to tell.

content.text:
I couldn't get the payment's stage, and the case is now waiting. I haven't told the customer anything about the payment.

I tried to ask the payment system, but the desk refused. The case is in the WAITING state, and the payment check only runs while a case is TRIAGED. The case status shows the case as final with the outcome "wait".

The case also shows two things that matter for the reply:
- **Not verified:** Mara Ellison is not verified, even though she says she is a signatory. Her claim alone doesn't change that.
- **No stage on record:** The case has no payment stage in it yet. The only payment record is the portal event showing the authorisation. That doesn't show whether the payment was sent or received.

I made no further tool calls, because none of the other options fit. A person can pick the case up once Mara is verified.
